techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/MaterialPreview.tsx:22 Each preview slot samples through the shared per-role table: albedo sRGB, normal/metallic/roughness/AO linear. Blender and the UE emitter read that same table.

src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/materialPreviewProps.ts:59 three.js, Blender Principled, and the UE script all store this scalar as roughness. No smoothness name and no negation in the lab projections.
src/components/modules/visual-gen/material-lab/materialTransfer.ts:52 Those three scalars are always sent as authored lab values. This module does not read an interchange file that can omit a factor.

src/__tests__/lib/visual-gen/material-boundary-swatch.test.ts:88 The test named as the surface swatch pins roughness at 0.5 and metallic at 0. It has no empty material, transparency, two-sided case, emissive-without-factor, or metalness pair.

pairs.registryProposal: The node application treats base-colour numeric agreement plus a per-role colour-space check as the swatch, while the technique also requires gloss extremes, an empty material, transparency, two-sidedness, emissive-without-factor, and a metalness pair.
